blocks.text: **even** biror narsa **kutilmagan**, odatdagidan tashqari ekanini ko'rsatadi: She speaks four languages; she **even** speaks Japanese — u hatto yaponcha ham gapiradi (buni kutmagandik). O'zbekchada bu ma'no ikki qism bilan beriladi: «**hatto** ... **ham**», ba'zan faqat «... **ham**» yoki «-da **ham**». Inglizchada esa bitta so'z — **even** — yetadi. **even** bir necha qolipda ishlatiladi: gap o'rtasida (fe'l yonida), ta'kidlanayotgan so'z oldida, inkorda (**not even**), qiyosiy daraja bilan (**even better**) va bog'lovchilar tarkibida (**even though**, **even if**, **even when**). Eng qiyini — oxirgisi: o'zbekchadagi bitta «-sa ham» inglizchada uch xil bo'ladi.

rows: **Even though** it was late, we went out.

blocks.text: **even** gap o'rtasidagi ravishlar guruhiga kiradi (→ 110-dars): oddiy fe'ldan oldin — She **even** cooked dinner for us; be dan keyin — He's **even** stricter at home; birinchi yordamchidan keyin — I've **even** started running. Bundan tashqari **even** ta'kidlanayotgan so'zning **oldiga** to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yilishi mumkin: **Even** my grandmother uses Instagram (hatto buvim ham); I work **even** on Sundays (hatto yakshanbada ham). O'zbekchadagi «ham» ni alohida tarjima qilmang: «Even my grandmother also uses...» — xato, **even** ning o'zi «hatto ... ham» ma'nosini beradi.

items.text: My brother loves Japan; he's **even** learning Japanese.
items.translation: Akam Yaponiyani yaxshi ko'radi, u **hatto** yapon tilini **ham** o'rganyapti.

items.text: **Even** the children enjoyed the classical concert.
The bakery on our street opens **even** on New Year's Day.
items.translation: Ko'chamizdagi nonvoyxona **hatto** Yangi yil kunida **ham** ochiq.

blocks.text: Inkor gapda **even** inkor yordamchi fe'ldan **keyin** turadi: I can't **even** remember his name; She didn't **even** say goodbye; They haven't **even** started. Ma'nosi: eng oddiy, eng kam kutilgan narsa ham bo'lmadi. O'zbekchada: «**hatto** ...-ni **ham** ...-madi». «She even didn't call» — xato tartib, to'g'risi: She did**n't even** call. Gap boshida **Not even** + ot: **Not even** his wife knew — hatto xotini ham bilmasdi.

rows: Men hatto tuxum qaynatishni ham bilmayman.
We haven't **even** opened the box yet.
**Not even** the teacher knew the answer.

items.text: I haven't **even** had breakfast yet, and it's already noon.
items.translation: Hali nonushta **ham** qilmadim, soat esa allaqachon o'n ikki.

items.text: They didn't **even** invite us to the wedding.
**Not even** the experts can predict the price of gold.
items.translation: Oltin narxini **hatto** mutaxassislar **ham** oldindan ayta olmaydi.

blocks.text: even + qiyosiy: even better, even more

Qiyosiy daraja oldida **even** — «**undan ham**», «**yanada**» (→ 106-dars). Uning **much** dan farqi bor: **much better** — shunchaki katta farq; **even better** — birinchisi ham yaxshi edi, ikkinchisi undan ham yaxshi. It was cold yesterday, and today it's **even colder** — kecha ham sovuq edi, degan ma'no bor. Ot bilan: **even more** people, **even less** time, **even fewer** mistakes. «even more better» — xato: **even better**.

items.text: This year's festival was **even bigger** than last year's.
items.translation: Bu yilgi festival o'tgan yilgidan **ham katta** bo'ldi.

items.text: Don't worry — the weather will be **even better** tomorrow.
items.translation: Xavotir olmang — ertaga havo **undan ham yaxshi** bo'ladi.

items.text: Taxis are expensive, but private drivers charge **even more**.
items.translation: Taksi qimmat, lekin xususiy haydovchilar **undan ham ko'p** pul oladi.

blocks.text: even though, even if, even when

O'zbekchadagi «**-sa ham**» uch xil vaziyatda ishlatiladi, inglizchada esa har biriga alohida bog'lovchi bor. **even though** — **fakt** (haqiqatan bo'lgan yoki bo'layotgan narsa), **although** ning kuchliroq shakli (→ 113-dars): **Even though** I was tired, I finished the report — charchagan edim (fakt), lekin tugatdim. **even if** — **ehtimol** yoki shart (bo'lishi ham, bo'lmasligi ham mumkin): **Even if** it rains, we'll go — yomg'ir yog'adimi-yo'qmi, bilmaymiz. Xayoliy vaziyatda **even if** + Past (→ 38-dars): **Even if** I had the money, I wouldn't buy it. **even when** — «har safar ...-ganda ham»: He wears a jacket **even when** it's hot. Ergash gap oldin (vergul bilan) yoki keyin kelishi mumkin. Yolg'iz **even** bog'lovchi bo'la olmaydi: «Even it was raining» — xato.

rows: **Even though** he's rich, he lives simply.
U boy bo'lsa ham (boy — fakt), oddiy yashaydi.
**Even if** he's rich, I won't marry him.
Agar boy bo'lsa ham, unga turmushga chiqmayman.
**Even if** I were rich, I'd still work.

items.text: **Even though** the tickets were cheap, the hall was half empty.
items.translation: Chiptalar arzon **bo'lsa ham**, zal yarim bo'sh edi.

items.text: **Even if** you don't feel hungry, try to eat something.
items.translation: Qorningiz och **bo'lmasa ham**, biror narsa yeyishga harakat qiling.

items.text: My grandmother wears a coat **even when** it's warm outside.
items.translation: Buvim tashqari iliq **bo'lganda ham** palto kiyadi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Even it was raining, we went out» → **Even though** it was raining; «Even I was tired, I worked» → **Even though** I was tired («Even I» = hatto men ham); «She even didn't call» → She didn't **even** call; «Even my grandmother also uses it» → **Even** my grandmother uses it; fakt uchun even if: «Even if he was ill yesterday, he came» → **Even though** he was ill; ehtimol uchun even though: «Even though it rains tomorrow» → **Even if** it rains tomorrow; «even more better» → **even better**.

«-sa ham» ni ko'rsangiz, savol bering: bu **fakt**mi (yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi)? → **even though**; **ehtimol** yoki xayolmi (yog'ishi mumkin)? → **even if**; **har safar**mi (yomg'ir yog'ganda ham doim)? → **even when**. «hatto ... ham» uchun esa bitta **even** yetadi.

Bog'lanish: **even so** — «shunday bo'lsa ham» (= **still** «baribir» ma'nosida, → 111-dars); although, though, in spite of — 113-dars; if + Past (xayoliy shart) — 38-dars; much / far + qiyosiy — 106-dars; gap o'rtasidagi ravishlar — 110-dars.

rows: **Even though** it was late, we stayed.

examples.title: **even** + verb: something surprising
examples.description: **even** gap o'rtasida — fe'l yonida: kutilmagan, odatdan tashqari harakat. O'zbekchada «hatto ... ham».

sentences.text: Aziz loves cooking; he **even** makes his own bread.
sentences.translation: Aziz ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko'radi, u **hatto** nonni **ham** o'zi yopadi.

sentences.text: The hotel was wonderful — they **even** gave us a free upgrade.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona ajoyib edi — ular bizni **hatto** bepul yaxshiroq xonaga **ham** o'tkazishdi.

sentences.text: Our new neighbour is very friendly; she's **even** offered to water our plants.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnimiz juda samimiy, u **hatto** gullarimizni sug'orib berishni **ham** taklif qildi.

sentences.text: Madina speaks four languages and can **even** read old Uzbek script.
sentences.translation: Madina to'rt tilda gapiradi va **hatto** eski o'zbek yozuvini **ham** o'qiy oladi.

sentences.text: The storm was so strong that it **even** damaged the roof of the school.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron shunchalik kuchli ediki, **hatto** maktab tomiga **ham** zarar yetkazdi.

sentences.text: James is a real football fan; he **even** named his dog after a player.
sentences.translation: Jeyms haqiqiy futbol muxlisi, u **hatto** itiga **ham** futbolchining ismini qo'ygan.

sentences.text: During the exam season, Nilufar **even** studies on the bus.
sentences.translation: Imtihonlar mavsumida Nilufar **hatto** avtobusda **ham** o'qiydi.

sentences.text: They've **even** started selling plov in supermarkets in London.
sentences.translation: Londondagi supermarketlarda **hatto** palov **ham** sotila boshladi.

sentences.text: Grandpa is so good with technology that he **even** fixes our phones.
sentences.translation: Bobom texnikaga shunchalik usta-ki, **hatto** telefonlarimizni **ham** tuzatadi.

sentences.text: Kate was so nervous before the interview that she **even** forgot her own phone number.
sentences.translation: Keyt suhbat oldidan shunchalik hayajonlandiki, **hatto** o'z telefon raqamini **ham** unutib qo'ydi.

examples.title: **Even** my grandmother ...: even + a word
examples.description: **even** ta'kidlanayotgan so'z oldida: **Even** the manager, **even** on holidays, **even** the hardest ones. «ham» alohida tarjima qilinmaydi.

sentences.text: **Even** my grandmother uses video calls now.
sentences.translation: Endi **hatto** buvim **ham** video qo'ng'iroqdan foydalanadi.

sentences.text: Everyone was surprised by the news, **even** the manager.
sentences.translation: Yangilikdan hamma hayron qoldi, **hatto** rahbar **ham**.

sentences.text: The museum is open every day, **even** on public holidays.
sentences.translation: Muzey har kuni ochiq, **hatto** bayram kunlari **ham**.

sentences.text: **Even** experienced drivers find this mountain road dangerous.
sentences.translation: Bu tog' yo'lini **hatto** tajribali haydovchilar **ham** xavfli deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: In Bukhara it can be warm **even** in November.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda **hatto** noyabrda **ham** havo iliq bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Jasur answered all the questions, **even** the hardest ones.
sentences.translation: Jasur barcha savollarga, **hatto** eng qiyinlariga **ham** javob berdi.

sentences.text: **Even** a small donation can help the children's hospital.
sentences.translation: **Hatto** kichik xayriya **ham** bolalar shifoxonasiga yordam berishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Bekzod works at weekends and **even** on his birthday.
sentences.translation: Bekzod dam olish kunlari va **hatto** tug'ilgan kunida **ham** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: That song is everywhere; you hear it **even** in taxis and lifts.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq hamma joyda yangraydi, uni **hatto** taksi va liftlarda **ham** eshitasiz.

sentences.text: In this exam, **even** the best students made silly mistakes.
sentences.translation: Bu imtihonda **hatto** eng yaxshi talabalar **ham** arzimas xatolarga yo'l qo'yishdi.

examples.title: **not even**: didn't **even** say thank you
examples.description: Inkorda **even** inkor yordamchi fe'ldan keyin: didn't **even**, can't **even**, haven't **even**; gap boshida **Not even** + ot.

sentences.text: He took the money and didn't **even** say thank you.
sentences.translation: U pulni oldi va **hatto** rahmat **ham** demadi.

sentences.text: I was so tired that I couldn't **even** finish my dinner.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik charchagan edimki, **hatto** kechki ovqatimni **ham** oxirigacha yeya olmadim.

sentences.text: Sarah lives next door, but I don't **even** know her surname.
sentences.translation: Sara qo'shnimiz, lekin men **hatto** uning familiyasini **ham** bilmayman.

sentences.text: The flat was so small that there wasn't **even** room for a table.
sentences.translation: Kvartira shunchalik kichik ediki, **hatto** stolga **ham** joy yo'q edi.

sentences.text: We haven't **even** unpacked yet, and the guests are arriving tonight.
sentences.translation: Biz hali yuklarimizni **ham** ochmadik, mehmonlar esa bugun kechqurun kelyapti.

sentences.text: **Not even** his closest friends knew that Oliver was leaving.
sentences.translation: Oliver ketayotganini **hatto** eng yaqin do'stlari **ham** bilishmasdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod can't **even** make tea, so his wife does all the cooking.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **hatto** choy damlashni **ham** bilmaydi, shuning uchun hamma ovqatni xotini pishiradi.

sentences.text: The shop was closed, and there wasn't **even** a sign on the door.
sentences.translation: Do'kon yopiq edi, eshikda **hatto** e'lon **ham** yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza didn't **even** look at me when she walked past.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yonimdan o'tib ketayotganda menga **hatto** qaramadi **ham**.

sentences.text: It isn't **even** nine o'clock, and the office is already full.
sentences.translation: Soat hali to'qqiz **ham bo'lmadi**, ofis esa allaqachon odamga to'la.

examples.title: **even** + comparative: **even better**, **even more**
examples.description: **even** + qiyosiy — «undan ham», «yanada»: birinchisi ham shunday edi, ikkinchisi undan ham ko'proq.

sentences.text: The first film was good, but the second one was **even better**.
sentences.translation: Birinchi film yaxshi edi, ikkinchisi esa **undan ham yaxshi** chiqdi.

sentences.text: It was hot yesterday, and today it's **even hotter**.
sentences.translation: Kecha issiq edi, bugun esa **undan ham issiq**.

sentences.text: Flights are expensive in August, and in December they're **even more expensive**.
sentences.translation: Avgustda parvozlar qimmat, dekabrda esa **yanada qimmat**.

sentences.text: Since the new shopping centre opened, the roads here have become **even busier**.
sentences.translation: Yangi savdo markazi ochilgandan beri bu yerdagi yo'llar **yanada gavjum** bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: Madina was always a good student, but at university she worked **even harder**.
sentences.translation: Madina doim yaxshi o'quvchi edi, universitetda esa **yanada astoydil** o'qidi.

sentences.text: If you add a little lemon, the soup will taste **even nicer**.
sentences.translation: Ozgina limon qo'shsangiz, sho'rva **yanada mazali** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: This year **even more** students applied for the scholarship than last year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil stipendiyaga o'tgan yilgidan **ham ko'proq** talaba ariza berdi.

sentences.text: We have **even less** time than we thought, so let's hurry.
sentences.translation: Vaqtimiz o'ylaganimizdan **ham kam**, shoshilaylik.

sentences.text: The new phone is fast, but the next model will be **even faster**, apparently.
sentences.translation: Yangi telefon tez, lekin aytishlaricha, keyingi modeli **undan ham tez** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Jasur thought the exam would be easy, but it was **even harder** than last year's.
sentences.translation: Jasur imtihon oson bo'ladi deb o'ylagan edi, lekin u o'tgan yilgidan **ham qiyin** bo'ldi.

examples.title: **even though**: in spite of a fact
examples.description: **even though** + fakt (haqiqatan bo'lgan narsa) — «...-sa ham», «...-ga qaramay». although ning kuchliroq shakli.

sentences.text: We went for a walk **even though** it was raining.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan **bo'lsa ham**, sayrga chiqdik.

sentences.text: **Even though** Aziz had a fever, he went to work.
sentences.translation: Azizning isitmasi **bo'lsa ham**, ishga bordi.

sentences.text: Kate didn't get the job, **even though** she had the best qualifications.
sentences.translation: Keyt eng yaxshi malakaga ega **bo'lishiga qaramay**, ishga olinmadi.

sentences.text: **Even though** we live in the same building, we hardly ever see each other.
sentences.translation: Bitta binoda yashasak **ham**, deyarli ko'rishmaymiz.

sentences.text: The restaurant was full **even though** it was a Monday night.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kechasi **bo'lishiga qaramay**, restoran to'la edi.

sentences.text: Bekzod still smokes, **even though** his doctor has warned him many times.
sentences.translation: Shifokor uni ko'p marta ogohlantirgan **bo'lsa ham**, Bekzod hali ham chekadi.

sentences.text: I really enjoyed the book, **even though** the ending was sad.
sentences.translation: Oxiri qayg'uli **bo'lsa ham**, kitob menga juda yoqdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza speaks perfect English, **even though** she has never lived abroad.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza hech qachon chet elda yashamagan **bo'lsa ham**, ingliz tilida mukammal gapiradi.

sentences.text: Our flight left on time **even though** there was heavy snow in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda kuchli qor **yog'ayotganiga qaramay**, reysimiz o'z vaqtida uchdi.

sentences.text: Why did you lend him money **even though** you knew he wouldn't pay it back?
sentences.translation: Qaytarmasligini **bilsang ham**, nega unga qarz berding?

examples.title: **even if**: possible or imaginary situations
examples.description: **even if** — ehtimol yoki shart («agar ... bo'lsa ham»); xayoliy vaziyatda **even if** + Past Simple va would.

sentences.text: **Even if** it rains tomorrow, the match will go ahead.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yomg'ir **yog'sa ham**, o'yin bo'lib o'tadi.

sentences.text: I'll finish this report tonight, **even if** I have to stay until midnight.
sentences.translation: Yarim tungacha qolishimga to'g'ri **kelsa ham**, bu hisobotni bugun tugataman.

sentences.text: Don't tell anyone about it, **even if** they ask you directly.
sentences.translation: Bu haqda hech kimga aytma, hatto to'g'ridan-to'g'ri **so'rashsa ham**.

sentences.text: You won't catch the last train **even if** you leave now.
sentences.translation: Hozir **chiqsangiz ham**, oxirgi poyezdga ulgurmaysiz.

sentences.text: Jasur wouldn't sell his old car **even if** someone offered him a fortune.
sentences.translation: Kimdir unga katta boylik **taklif qilsa ham**, Jasur eski mashinasini sotmasdi.

sentences.text: **Even if** I had more free time, I wouldn't spend it on social media.
sentences.translation: Bo'sh vaqtim ko'proq **bo'lganida ham**, uni ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga sarflamasdim.

sentences.text: Always wear a helmet, **even if** you're only cycling to the shop.
sentences.translation: Faqat do'kongacha velosipedda **borsangiz ham**, doim dubulg'a kiying.

sentences.text: Sarah would still love Tom **even if** he lost all his money.
sentences.translation: Tom butun pulidan **ayrilsa ham**, Sara uni baribir sevardi.

sentences.text: We'll have the party in the garden, **even if** it's a bit cold.
sentences.translation: Biroz salqin **bo'lsa ham**, ziyofatni bog'da o'tkazamiz.

sentences.text: It's worth seeing this show in London, **even if** the tickets are expensive.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar qimmat **bo'lsa ham**, Londonda bu shouni ko'rishga arziydi.

examples.title: **even when**: every time, without exception
examples.description: **even when** — «hatto ...-ganda ham»: takrorlanadigan vaziyat, har safar shunday bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Grandpa goes swimming in the river **even when** the water is cold.
sentences.translation: Bobom suv sovuq **bo'lganda ham** daryoda cho'miladi.

sentences.text: Oliver keeps working **even when** he's on holiday.
sentences.translation: Oliver ta'tilda **bo'lganda ham** ishlashda davom etadi.

sentences.text: Madina smiles **even when** things go wrong.
sentences.translation: Madina ishlar chappasiga **ketganda ham** jilmayadi.

sentences.text: **Even when** the shop is busy, the staff are always polite.
sentences.translation: Do'kon gavjum **bo'lganda ham**, xodimlar doim xushmuomala.

sentences.text: The traffic in the city centre is heavy **even when** it's late at night.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazida tirbandlik kech kechasi **bo'lganda ham** kuchli bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Our cat sleeps on the sofa **even when** we tell her not to.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz biz ruxsat **bermasak ham** divanda uxlaydi.

sentences.text: Jasur speaks Uzbek with his children **even when** they answer in English.
sentences.translation: Bolalari inglizcha javob **berganda ham**, Jasur ular bilan o'zbekcha gaplashadi.

sentences.text: **Even when** she was ill, Kate checked her work emails every hour.
sentences.translation: Kasal **bo'lganida ham**, Keyt har soatda ish xatlarini tekshirardi.

sentences.text: Some people wear sunglasses **even when** the sky is cloudy.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi odamlar osmon bulutli **bo'lganda ham** quyosh ko'zoynagi taqib yuradi.

sentences.text: The baby cries **even when** we hold her, so we've called the doctor.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq qo'limizga **olganimizda ham** yig'layveradi, shuning uchun shifokorni chaqirdik.

examples.title: Dialogue: a rainy holiday in Edinburgh
examples.description: Ikki do'st yomg'irli ta'til haqida gaplashadi: **even**, **not even**, **even more**, **even though**, **even if**, **even when**.

sentences.text: — How was your holiday in Edinburgh? Did it rain **even** in July?
sentences.translation: — Edinburgdagi ta'tiling qalay o'tdi? **Hatto** iyulda **ham** yomg'ir yog'dimi?

sentences.text: — Every single day! We didn't **even** see the sun once.
sentences.translation: — Har kuni! Quyoshni bir marta **ham** ko'rmadik.

sentences.text: — Oh no! Did you enjoy it, **even though** the weather was so bad?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Ob-havo shunchalik yomon **bo'lsa ham**, sizlarga yoqdimi?

sentences.text: — Yes, actually. The old town looks **even more** beautiful in the rain.
sentences.translation: — Ha, aslida. Eski shahar yomg'irda **yanada** chiroyli ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: — What about the food? Did you **even** try haggis?
sentences.translation: — Ovqat-chi? Haggisni tatib **ham** ko'rdingmi?

sentences.text: — Of course! **Even** Bekzod liked it, and he hates trying new food.
sentences.translation: — Albatta! **Hatto** Bekzodga **ham** yoqdi, holbuki u yangi taomlarni yomon ko'radi.

sentences.text: — Really? He doesn't **even** eat fish!
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? U **hatto** baliq **ham** yemaydi-ku!

sentences.text: — I know! He **even** asked for the recipe before we left.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman! U ketishimizdan oldin **hatto** retseptini **ham** so'radi.

sentences.text: — Would you go back there, **even if** it rained every day again?
sentences.translation: — Yana har kuni yomg'ir **yog'sa ham**, u yerga qaytib borarmidingiz?

sentences.text: — Definitely. **Even when** it's grey and wet, Edinburgh is magical.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Kulrang va nam **bo'lganda ham**, Edinburg sehrli.
